Returns and exchanges are accepted within 30 days of receiving your order.
Items must be in their original condition, unused, and with all tags attached.
Read our return policy here.
For US Orders:
Exchanges: Free!
Returns: A flat $8 restocking fee will be deducted from your refund.
Please visit our returns portal here
For International Orders:
Exchanges: Unfortunately, we are unable to offer exchanges for international orders.

turns.q: Do I have to pay anything to return the damaged item?
How long does the replacement take?
turns.replyText:
How long does the replacement take?Ask MaggieThe replacement process typically takes a few business days once your claim is approved. You'll receive an email with tracking information as soon as your replacement ships.

Title: What if I received the wrong item or a defective product?
Contact customer service immediately with your order number, a description of the issue, and photos if possible. We'll arrange a replacement or repair at no cost if it falls under warranty or was an error on our part.

Title: How long will it take to receive my order?
Standard Orders will typically ship pack and ship in 2-4 business days (Mon-Fri) and you will receive your order in 3-4 business days (Mon-Fri) once shipped.
Expedited Orders received by 12pm PST ship same day (M-F) otherwise will ship out in 2 to 4 weekdays.
*Some international orders may have extra taxes/duties.

Title: Can I return or exchange an item?
All U.S. online orders may be returned or exchanged within 30 days free of charge! Begin your return or exchange process by simply visiting the Bandolier returns/exchange center here.
To be eligible, items must be unworn, undamaged and unmarked, and in their original packaging.

Title: Can I exchange an item?
All U.S. online orders may be exchanged within 30 days free of charge! Begin your exchange process by simply visiting the Bandolier returns/exchange center here.
To be eligible, items must be unworn, undamaged and unmarked, and in their original packaging.
